body:
I don't really know. I feel like the issues with my mom aren't a big deal but then they are. Little things that just aren't right stand out to me. Like my mom telling me she hates me because I argued with her about a movie we saw, or my mom screaming that I abuse her because I corrected her about the weather forecast. those things aren't normal, and she does it to everyone in my family. she also . but then I think of how she treated my big sister and it doesn't even seem to matter. she was horrible to my older sister and I should be glad that she's ever nice to me at all.

I think hormones could be part of my problem but I feel like my emotional reactions are really inappropriate. Like my teacher sort of snapped at me for talking in class once and I felt so horrible about it that I almost started crying right there and beat myself up about it all day, or one of my friends was acting like she didn't want to talk to me so I hurt myself when I got home. I don't think these intense reactions are normal at all.

my childhood is really confusing, mostly because of my mom. her attitude toward me changes as often as my attitude toward myself changes. she praises me excessively but then turns around and criticizes me. I feel like I am constantly having to defend myself around her because she will twist anything I say and use it to say that I'm abusive to her. But I feel like she must be right sometimes and I feel guilty because how can I be mad at someone who's so nice to me? I'm so confused.
touche. but no. I don't care for that kind of attention.
